snippet.title: Elevator Teaser - DEMO OUT NOW!
snippet.description:
PLAY THE DEMO TODAY: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4225420/Elevator_Demo/
PRE-ORDER AND SUPPORT US ON KICKSTARTER: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pixeltailgames/elevator-1


Elevator is a re-imagining and standalone sequel to: Elevator: Source.

Elevator is an absurdist, comedy-horror multiplayer game. Every time you play, you’re in for a different ride. What floor will you stop on? Will you escape? Do you want to? The Elevator decides your fate.

More info on Elevator: https://playelevator.com/
